lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters, equidistantly spaced in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges extend along the dorsal-lateral surface, showing a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Roughly 15 distinct high-luminance blobs are scattered within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher density of spots located near the anterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serration and multiple V-shaped notches are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high-frequency distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger-scale patterning on the main body.
